paper.title_en: Quasinormal modes of Kerr--de Sitter black holes in semi-open systems
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the gravitational quasinormal mode spectrum of Kerr--de Sitter black holes with a partially reflective inner boundary near the event horizon, by reducing the angular and radial Teukolsky equations to Heun equations. We vary different parameters and study the $s=-2$, $\ell=m=2$ modes numerically. As the reflectivity $\mathcal{R}_0$ increases, QNMs develop echo branches approaching the real axis with approximately regular spacing, while others approach $\operatorname{Re}ω=mΩ(r_+)$. As the rotation $a$ increases, some QNMs approach the real axis or retain finite damping, while others exhibit approximately horizontal shifts with real parts tracking $mΩ(r_+)$. Two mechanisms driving the instabilities are identified in complementary regimes, namely superradiant amplification and energy injection from the reflective wall. We derive the ratio between Teukolsky amplitude and energy reflectivities, finding that the latter can diverge at $mΩ(r_+)$ even when the former is small, which accounts for an active wall in this regime. We also find that formulating the reflective boundary condition in terms of asymptotic amplitudes gives rise to resonances near each pole of the ingoing connection coefficient, extending to arbitrarily large positive imaginary parts. An exact finite radius Robin condition imposed on the Sasaki--Nakamura variable removes these pole-born frequencies. These results show how the inner boundary prescription controls the spectrum structure and stability of semi-open Kerr--de Sitter systems.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究Kerr–de Sitter黑洞在半开放边界条件下的准正规模谱，将Teukolsky方程约化为Heun方程并进行数值扫描，讨论了超辐射放大、反射壁能量注入、Teukolsky振幅与能量反射率之比以及极点诱发的共振等机制，理论上较深入且对边界条件如何决定谱结构给出具体分析，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 半开放系统中Kerr–de Sitter黑洞的准正规模
decision.abstract_zh: 我们通过将角向与径向Teukolsky方程约化为Heun方程，研究了具有靠近事件视界的部分反射内边界的Kerr–de Sitter黑洞的引力准正规模谱。我们改变不同参数，并对$s=-2$、$\ell=m=2$模式进行数值研究。随着反射率$\mathcal{R}_0$增大，准正规模发展出趋近实轴、间距近似规则的回声分支，而另一些则趋近$\operatorname{Re}ω=mΩ(r_+)$。随着转动$a$增大，一些准正规模趋近实轴或保持有限阻尼，而另一些表现出近似水平的移动，其实部跟踪$mΩ(r_+)$。在互补的区域内识别出驱动不稳定性的两种机制，即超辐射放大与来自反射壁的能量注入。我们推导了Teukolsky振幅反射率与能量反射率之间的比值，发现后者即使在$mΩ(r_+)$处前者很小时也可能发散，这解释了该区域内活跃壁的作用。我们还发现，用以渐近振幅表述的反射边界条件会在入射连接系数的每个极点附近产生共振，并延伸至任意大的正虚部。施加在Sasaki–Nakamura变量上的精确有限半径Robin条件消除了这些极点诱发的频率。这些结果表明，内边界规定如何控制半开放Kerr–de Sitter系统的谱结构与稳定性。
